title: You Think Quiet Dry Rooms Always Boost Memory, Yet Scuba Divers Remembered More Underwater
description:
You think warm dry rooms always help memory! Yet cold dark water beat a sunny shore! This is the true story of Godden and Baddeley's scuba divers. Here is what went wrong on Scottish diving boats.
